review_candidates.title: Network Technician
review_candidates.location: Qesm El Obour, Al Qalyubiyah, Egypt
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Install, maintain, and troubleshoot network cabling and related equipment across HQ and remote sites. Key Responsibilities: Network Cabling & Installation: Install, terminate, label, and test copper and fiber-optic cabling, outlets, patch panels, and patch cords. Organize racks, cabinets, and cable routes, maintaining clear labeling and proper cable management. Check power, uplinks, PoE connections, and physical connectivity during installations and troubleshooting. Troubleshooting & Maintenance
eligibility_evidence: Site Support & Documentation: Support site surveys, office relocations, and network installations across Group locations.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Requirements Technical diploma or equivalent qualification in Electronics, Telecommunications, Networking, or a related field. Minimum 2 years of relevant experience in structured cabling and network installation.
